functions.name: initialize
functions.description: Initializes the invoice contract with an admin address

functions.name: create_invoice
functions.description: Creates a new invoice

functions.name: batch_create_invoice
functions.description: Creates multiple invoices atomically

functions.name: mark_paid
functions.description: Marks an invoice as paid

functions.name: get_invoice
functions.description: Retrieves an invoice by ID

functions.name: get_invoice_status
functions.description: Returns the status of an invoice

functions.name: batch_get_invoice_status
functions.description: Returns the status of multiple invoices

functions.name: get_invoices_page
functions.description: Returns a page of invoices

functions.name: cancel_invoice
functions.description: Cancels a pending invoice

functions.name: amend_invoice
functions.description: Amends a pending invoice's amount fields

functions.description: Requests a refund for a paid invoice

functions.name: approve_refund
functions.description: Approves a refund request

functions.name: reject_refund
functions.description: Rejects a refund request

functions.description: Releases escrow for a paid invoice

functions.name: batch_expire
functions.description: Expires pending invoices whose expiry has passed

functions.name: pause
functions.description: Pauses the contract

functions.name: unpause
functions.description: Unpauses the contract

functions.name: set_grace_window
functions.description: Sets the grace window for payment validity

functions.name: get_grace_window
functions.description: Returns the current grace window

functions.name: accept_admin
functions.description: Completes a two-step admin transfer

functions.name: extend_expiry
functions.description: Extends the expiry of a pending invoice

functions.name: get_invoice_count
functions.description: Returns the total number of invoices created

functions.description: Returns a page of invoice IDs for a merchant

functions.description: Returns all pending invoice IDs

functions.name: transfer_admin

functions.description: Sets the refund network fee in stroops (admin only, bounded by MAX_REFUND_NETWORK_FEE)

functions.name: get_refund_network_fee
functions.description: Returns the current refund network fee in stroops

functions.name: create_template
functions.description: Creates a reusable invoice template

functions.name: generate_from_template
functions.description: Generates a new invoice from an existing template

functions.name: disable_template
functions.description: Disables an invoice template

functions.name: get_template
functions.description: Retrieves a template by ID

functions.name: get_template_count
functions.description: Returns the total number of templates created

functions.name: get_templates_by_merchant
functions.description: Returns a page of template IDs for a merchant
